pillars.label: Environmental
pillars.question: How carefully do they treat the planet?

pillars.label: Economic
pillars.question: Can they keep doing good work without falling apart?

pillars.label: Governance
pillars.question: Who is in charge, and can we trust them?

factors.label: Carbon Footprint
factors.plain: Whether they actually account for Scope 1, 2, and 3 greenhouse gases.

factors.label: Climate Promise Score
factors.plain: How credible the climate target is — Net Zero Tracker + Science Based Targets.

factors.label: Clean Energy Shift
factors.plain: How far they have moved toward renewable and clean power.

factors.label: Resource Efficiency
factors.plain: How carefully they use water, materials, and waste.

factors.label: Environmental Track Record
factors.plain: Whether their history shows care — or cleanup after harm.

factors.label: Leadership Diversity
factors.plain: Whether leadership reflects a wider mix of people.

factors.label: Worker Wellbeing
factors.plain: How they look after health, safety, and day-to-day care.

factors.label: Pay Fairness
factors.plain: Whether pay looks fair across roles and genders.

factors.label: Customer Trust
factors.plain: Signals that customers and the public can rely on them.

factors.label: Fair Labor Practices
factors.plain: Respect for people in their own operations and supply chain.

factors.label: People Score
factors.plain: A wide-angle view of how they talk about their workforce.

factors.label: Financial Stability
factors.plain: Whether the business looks sturdy enough to keep its promises.

factors.label: Growth & Innovation
factors.plain: Investment in new ideas, products, and better ways of working.

factors.label: Profitability
factors.plain: Whether they earn enough to fund the transition, not just talk about it.

factors.label: Investment in the Future
factors.plain: Money going into long-term capacity, climate, and people.

factors.label: Job & Wage Impact
factors.plain: Whether they create decent work and share value with workers.

factors.label: Board Independence
factors.plain: How independent the people who oversee management are.

factors.label: Executive Accountability
factors.plain: Whether leaders' pay and job security are tied to real outcomes.

factors.label: Ethics Record
factors.plain: Integrity — and the absence of serious ethics trouble.

factors.label: Transparency
factors.plain: How openly they report, using shared climate and ESG standards.

factors.label: Ownership Fairness
factors.plain: Whether ordinary shareholders have a real voice.
